newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Boeing expects U.S. to end merger review end June.
newsitem.headline: Boeing expects U.S. to end merger review end June.

text.p: Boeing Co's vice-president for European affairs Jim Frank said on Wednesday he expected that the Federal Trade Commission of the United States would complete the review of its merger with McDonnell Douglas Corp by the end of June or early July.
"The latest I have heard is that the U.S. authority is trying to complete their assessment towards the end of June, early July," Frank told Reuters.

The announcement, if confirmed, clearly indicates that the FTC intends to take the lead in the investigation of the mega-merger between the two aircraft manufacturers about which the European Commission has raised strong doubts.
It was originally expected that the United States would complete its assessment after the Commission had ruled, which must happen by July 31.
